title: Item:Fragmented Ability Tome
wikitext:
__NOTOC__ [[File:Fragmented Charisma Tome UI.png|thumb|right|250px|Fragmented Charisma Tome UI]] Double-click Fragmented Tomes to open a barter box with the option of a +1 Tome or every available Upgrade Tome (from +1->+2 to +7->+8) for the ability indicated in that Fragmented Tome's name. * A +1 Tome provides a flat +1 bonus to the indicated ability and can only be used if the character trying to use it has no existing Inherent bonus to that ability. * Upgrade Tomes upgrade an ability one step at a time, and can only be used when the target character has an Inherent bonus to the specified ability ''exactly'' equal to the first number in its name. (For example, a character with a +3 bonus to Constitution may only use a +3 to +4 Upgrade Tome of Constitution; other Upgrade Tomes will not function if that character attempts to use it.) == Tips == {{see also|1=Item:Ability tome|l1=Ability tome}} * Tomes provided from this item's barter box are Bound to Account on Acquire, like the item itself. * Before purchasing an upgrade tome, remember that you can check your Feats on your Character Sheet to see what Inherent bonuses you already have and therefore which tome you need next. == Fragmented Strength Tome == {{Consumable | name = Fragmented Strength Tome | picdesc = Fragmented Strength Tome.png | acquired = [[Sterling the Strongbox]] | location =
